These unmodified license texts are from QMT v0.2.4, commit:
0fa8d32eb461e14d78e9ddbd569664ea59bcea19

Original directory:
https://github.com/dlaidig/qmt/tree/0fa8d32eb461e14d78e9ddbd569664ea59bcea19/LICENSES

The official PyPI qmt-0.2.4.tar.gz omits this directory. The standalone
application's Python-only wheel restores these files and retains all 27
qmt/**/*.py files, including their original SPDX copyright and license notices.
Checksums are enforced in prepare_qmt_wheel.py. LicenseRef-Unspecified.txt
describes upstream's status for marked source; it does not grant a new license.
